review_scope: All 23 current main and candidate pairs reviewed for continuity of installed materials and geometry. Some light and highlight levels vary. The separate installed mirror route covers the Toon Lily appearance.

images.observation: The table, floor, hanging fixture, and companion retain their mapped finishes.
The lamp beam crosses complete tile courses and grout. The curtain and trim remain visible.
The slatted blind, floor, rug, furniture and resident clothing remain distinct.
The room's boards, furniture, shelf and window retain their surface separation.
Cabinet, sink and wall materials retain their appearance through the broad pool from the companion.
Boiler casing, dial, pipes and room surfaces remain distinguishable under low lighting.
Shelf stock, doorway and adjacent furniture remain visible. The candidate's near table and chair read warmer.
Tile joints and the fittings remain legible at the same close stance.
The brick and mortar remain visible in the dark service close view.
The fuse plate, terminals and conduit remain distinct. The door finish appears warmer in the candidate.
The dog, brass rail and tile remain present under the bar.
The cat, ledge and wall portrait remain visible under the same low spill.
The beam, portraits and back shelving retain their separate finishes.
Mail slots, plaques and bench stay visible. The candidate brass catches less front light.
Fins, valve, hanging cloth and wall contacts remain present.
Roof landing posts, rails, floor and stair opening remain clear.
Tank, legs, roof and skyline retain their separate profiles.
The terminal glow, field board and timber floor remain distinct.
The rendered tile grid, cistern cover and side hardware remain visible.
The patterned floor residue retains its colours below the radiator.
The raised growth, radiator and floor remain visibly separate in the warm beam.
All appliances, containers and crumbs remain visible. The toaster and containers look darker and warmer.
Station face and dial remain present. The candidate wall catches warmer edge lighting.
